findings.anchor: 本人が健康状態を1から5までの点数で答え
findings.problem: The original NHIS question asks respondents for a verbal health category; researchers assign1–5 to those categories. This wording instead says respondents provided numeric point answers. The range is right but the description of elicitation is slightly inaccurate.
findings.fix: Say 「本人が答えた健康状態を、1から5までの点数にしたものです。点数が高いほど健康です。」 or an equally natural formulation distinguishing the answer from its numeric coding.

evidence.quote: We used this question to code an index that assigns 5 to excellent health and 1 to poor health
